summary: The candidate is a substantive partial fix: ordinary intrinsically oversized hybrid-SWA requests are rejected with HTTP 400 handling and no longer pin the queue, while transient pressure still defers. However, the reachable ignore_eos plus disabled-prefix-cache admission path bypasses the new rejection branch and continues to return NO_TOKEN forever for an intrinsically impossible request.

tests.what_was_measured: Base behavior for the reported 20,742/20,992 geometry, permanent 512- and 1,023-token zero-page-cap cases, and transient pressure; the permanent cases returned NO_TOKEN on three attempts.
Candidate regression file: 34 passed, 12 subtests passed.
Independent permanent/transient boundaries and an adversarial ignore_eos disabled-prefix-cache case; the latter returned NO_TOKEN on three attempts without rejection.

gpu_execution_evidence: No GPU kernels were needed or launched by the deterministic PrefillAdder tests. rocminfo/rocm-smi enumerated the assigned GPU as AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950.
remaining_counterexamples: With a hybrid SWA pool of size_swa=rem_swa=512, page_size=512, a 2,000-token prompt, max_new_tokens=1, ignore_eos=True, and prefix caching disabled (tree_cache.disable=True), add_one_req dispatches to add_one_req_ignore_eos and returns NO_TOKEN indefinitely without terminal rejection.
remaining_limitations: The reported 1P1D TP4+TP4 mooncake TCP multi-node 8xB300 deployment was unavailable; only one assigned gfx950 MI355X was visible.
The deterministic scheduler-admission path did not launch GPU kernels and does not validate full HTTP transport, model semantics, transfer, or distributed behavior.
No native source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
